notes: NEW subject pack: Sociology Basics — culture, norms and values, socialization, deviance, social stratification, social institutions, roles and role conflict, and the sociological imagination, with fresh-number practice (survey percentages, response rates) and which-idea scenarios, never your assignment.

Detector V25 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 13 of 18 humanized texts, tying the shipped V20, so V20 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. The audit-driven round did move two deep misses (food waste apps and night trains now caught) but lost beekeeping, and it improved the false-flag rate to 4.50% (from V20’s 4.71%) and neural-paraphrase detection to 53.3% (from 51.1%).
